ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(Bypass_Validation__c), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification'), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ), Amount >= 25000, OR( ISBLANK(Total_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c), Total_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c = 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Total Sales Billing Estimate must be confirmed before moving this Opportunity from Negotiation to Booking Verification.
